sections.description: To get highlight text, write your description like this: ex 1: --> This is a regular paragraph with important details highlighted. ex 2: --> This is a regular paragraph with important details highlighted. Here, mark is built in a tag, and highlight is a class. The following classes we'll be using in the blog to highlight text are given below: 1. highlight 2. hred 3. hgreen 4. hyellow 5. hblue 6. horange 7. hindigo 8. hviolet 9. hwhite 10. hgray
